gaps.sentence: The teacher made us ___ the whole essay again.
gaps.explanation: 'Make someone do' — active 'make' takes the bare infinitive.

gaps.sentence: He spent months ___ the application, only to be rejected in minutes.
gaps.explanation: 'Spend time doing something' takes the gerund.

gaps.sentence: She insisted on ___ for the meal herself.
It's no use ___ to start the engine — the battery is completely flat.
gaps.explanation: 'It's no use' is followed by a gerund.

gaps.sentence: We managed ___ everyone before the storm hit.
If you keep ___ like this, you'll exhaust yourself.
gaps.explanation: keep (+ on) is followed by -ing: keep working.

gaps.sentence: I really can't afford ___ on holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: afford takes the to-infinitive: can't afford to go.
avoid is followed by -ing: avoid talking.
